summary: Added a READ-ONLY collision preflight to plan_command_readonly: would_collide + collision_preflight fields report whether the plan's task_id/runner would collide with an ACTIVE claim (pending/processing/review/blocked). Reads the same task-card JSONL the tasking collision guard scans (scripts/build_tasking_parallel_group_collision_guard_v1.py: load_cards + canonical_status + ACTIVE_STATUSES) with a plain file read -- no lock acquired, no claim written, no queue/audit mutation, no subprocess/exec/fork/shell code added. Card source is env-overridable (GEOAI_TASK_MCP_COLLISION_CARDS_PATH, falling back to the existing BITNN_TASK_CARDS_PATH override) so tests point it at an isolated temp file. write_gate stays default-off; secret redaction unchanged.

public_api_added.collision_preflight(task_id, runner, top: would_collide + detail dict, plain read-only file read
public_api_added.plan_command_readonly(...): now also returns plan['would_collide'] and plan['collision_preflight']
